answers.description:
An answers file (`answers.ron`), from the working folder: its
answers in place of the short name's.

dir.description:
The new game's folder, from the working folder: made if missing,
and refused unless empty (or `force`).

engine.description: Where it gets the engine from.

force.description: Write into a folder that isn't empty, over the files there.

name.description: The game's name; the folder's name if none.

set.description:
Answers by question, in place of the short name's and the file's
(`--set perspective=top-down-grid`).

template.description:
A short name of the template's for a set of answers (`grid`,
`blank`); none for none.

Answers.description:
The answers a game picked: by question id, the ids of its answers, as
`answers.ron` holds them (`{ "perspective": ["top-down-grid"] }`).

Engine.description: Where the new game gets the engine from.

oneOf.description: The engine's repository at its `main` branch.
The engine's repository at a commit.
A checkout of the engine on this machine.
